AMAZING, gonna def go back!
Sep 2026 • Couples
Amazing experience, we came in and were welcomed with lots of attention and attention to detail! Staff is very nice and super helpful. Very attentive to everything! The food was AMAZING if you don’t love fish (which is very fresh and smooth!) don’t worry they got you! They got curries, meats, vegetables and a lot of other options! They clean your table right away so you always have space! Inside is very nice and the detail on the walls is immaculate. The spicy Edamame is one of our favourites! We had the lime soda! Also so yummy and perfect for the hot weather! It is located in the city! So very easy to get to!
